Filed pursuant to Rule 424(b)(4) Registration No. 333-297294

Up to 50,000,000 Class A Ordinary Shares

Wellchange Holdings Company Limited (the “Company,” “we,” “us,” and “our”) is offering on a best-efforts basis up to 50,000,000 Class A Ordinary Shares, par value $0.000005 per share (the “Class A Ordinary Shares”), at a public offering price of $0.15 per Class A Ordinary Share (the “Offering”).

The offering will terminate upon the completion of a single closing, which is expected to occur on or about August 31, 2026.

Because there is no minimum offering amount required as a condition to closing, the actual offering amount, Placement Agent fees and proceeds to us, if any, may be substantially less than the maximum amounts set forth above.
